planning_decision.label: Pacific South Equatorial Countercurrent
planning_decision.next_action: Recover compatible numerical total-flow axes and paired boundaries; keep WOA01 surface/0-200 m geostrophy relative to 1500 dbar separate from modeled Sverdrup flow and band-passed anomaly sections at 170 E. Do not use anomaly zero contours as width edges, averaging windows as endpoints, or merge them with the newer Argo envelopes. See research/pacific-secc-woa01-anomaly-scope-audit.json; full 2026 methods and seasonal calendars remain needed.
planning_decision.scope: Argo-based analysis reports a boreal-spring band near 5–13°S from 150°E to 170°W, with seasonal changes in zonal reach and depth. That observed seasonal envelope is not a traced alongstream length and is unranked.

document.geographic_rule: Longitude limits are source-envelope gates, not flow origin/termination. Spring latitude limits are not paired current edges. No rectangle or midpoint line is an observed footprint or axis. Dateline differences use eastward modulo 360, never a 320/290 degree westward span.
remaining_gates: Inspect full methods and source season definitions; recover averaging years and exact month membership.
Recover source-supported longitudinal axes and compatible layer/velocity boundaries before length or width calculation.
Separate ENSO composites from seasonal climatology and justify named-flow endpoints.
Independent scientific and canonical admission review.
document.scope: Reported seasonal geographic envelopes from Argo-derived absolute geostrophic currents; not a measured current axis or velocity-boundary width.
document.source_access: Publisher preview inspected. Full methods, figures and supplementary file not acquired; study averaging years and calendar-month definitions unresolved.
document.source_citation: Wu, Yang and Liang (2026), Seasonal and Interannual Variability of the Pacific South Equatorial Countercurrent Based on Argo Profiles, doi:10.1029/2025JC023053.
document.source_locator: Publisher abstract, Plain Language Summary and Data Availability Statement.

Recover longitudinal connected velocity-core support and source-defined gates before tracing a route; do not bridge separated positive components.
Use paired total-flow boundaries for local width extraction; anomaly zero crossings remain inadmissible as current-width edges.
Keep 2004 relative-geostrophic support separate from the 2026 Argo absolute-geostrophic envelopes and ENSO composites.
Independent scientific boundary, identity and canonical admission review.
